highlights.reason_zh: 公开代码把专家协作纳入 MoE 剪枝，可直接验证显存与质量取舍；厂商 benchmark 仍需复现。
highlights.reason_en: Public code includes expert cooperation in MoE pruning and makes the memory-quality tradeoff directly testable; publisher benchmarks still need reproduction.

highlights.reason_zh: 会话诊断、LSP 与外部个人记忆直接影响长任务可靠性和数据边界，适合在隔离仓库做验收。
highlights.reason_en: Session diagnostics, LSP and external personal memory directly affect long-task reliability and data boundaries, making an isolated acceptance test worthwhile.

highlights.reason_zh: 两套 CC BY 4.0 数据把日语金融模拟与 PII 测试变成可直接下载的工程材料，但不能把合成等同于合规。
highlights.reason_en: Two CC BY 4.0 datasets make Japanese finance simulation and PII testing directly downloadable, without making synthetic data equivalent to compliance.

coverage_zh: 36 个固定入口全部成功并读完，并补搜模型、工具、研究、开源、基础设施、政策、小团队与中外文材料。两篇 11 月 9 日文章只有日期精度；三项技术效果均缺独立复现，arXiv 周末入口未出现新提交。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors succeeded and were read, with additional searches across models, tools, research, open source, infrastructure, policy, small teams and multilingual sources. The two November 9 articles have date-only precision; all three technical effects lack independent reproduction, and the weekend arXiv feed had no new submissions.
